title: Integral and rational finiteness from cohomological control
statement: For D,l,E as in point-sections finiteness, every integral constructible complex has canonical point sections with bounded finitely generated derived-complete cohomology, and its scalar extension along O_E into E has bounded finite-dimensional cohomology.

source.place: the assertion that evaluation at the geometric point lands in $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}$

proof.text: Apply cohomological control to obtain bounded support, derived completeness and finite residue of every cohomology module. The coefficient DVR is Noetherian. Apply finite_module_adic_complete_and_hom to the rank-one module O_E to obtain ring completeness; transport along ULift.ringEquiv, mapping the principal ideal. A finite residue set is a finitely generated residue module. Apply finite_and_completion_bijective_of_isDerivedComplete to obtain finite generation of each integral cohomology module. The coefficient-field uniformizer-localization theorem gives flatness of the inclusion O_E into E, and RingHom.Flat.ulift_iff gives flatness of the exact scalar map used here. Apply flat scalar-extension finite cohomology. Derived completeness of every cohomology module follows from lem-weil-derived-complete-homology.

proof_origin.place: Point evaluation, finite/integral/rational landing assertions; original six-step proof, specialized as recorded

theorem point_sections_finiteness_integral (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∀ C : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ,
      sfIntegralConstructible l E (Spec (.of D.k)) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) →
        DerivedCategory.pointFgComplete (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
          (Ideal.span {ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E)})
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)) ∧
        DerivedCategory.pointFiniteDimensional (ULift.{u + 1, u} E)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (pointIntegralToField l E)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj
              (((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))))
